notes: Group: Everything Else. FULL portrait SITE overlay printed sideways (both halves); NOT renamed — bars read '•CORUSCANT: JEDI COUNCIL CHAMBER' (red • on the Light bar, white • on the Dark bar). Light half (right column) = game_text; Dark half (left column) = dark_text; line breaks as the slip prints them. Light Force slot: THREE blue sabers (light_force_count 3, as the printed 3/0 site). Dark Force slot empty black → dark_force false (printed card has no Dark icon either). Icon boxes both bars, outermost first: planet (pink Coruscant-era planet), interior (tan); no scomp. INLINE ICON before 'Wipe Them Out, All Of Them': purple/white sphere = Original Virtual Set 9 sphere (pixel-matched to assets/icons/ovs-set-9.png; same as vs13/03) → {ovs:9}; the stub drops it. Bottom margin of the slip: VS16 sphere + black EPISODE I disc → icons ['episode1'] (the printed card carries the Coruscant ring + Episode I icon beside the art). CHANGES vs printed card (Coruscant): both texts replaced (printed Light: '[Episode I] Yoda may deploy here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to Revolution.'; Dark: 'Non-unique lightsaber Force drain bonuses everywhere are canceled.'). Slip text matches the stub (except the dropped {ovs:9}). Base 490×353 only; copyright Coruscant 2001 line by set (vs14/11 practice; vertical line only partly legible, reads 2001). Modern: VB5-L-coruscantjedicouncilchamber-pre.gif (Virtual Block 5 reissue — prints a VB5 diamond '5' before Wipe Them Out). Sites have no lore. Art: printed scan by its measured Episode I window (art.rect; no zoom — Bill 2026-10-14).
